Journal 2.0 — chosen direction

Keeps the book but makes it work harder: a real contents page with photos and edge tabs, AI replies written as margin notes and sticky notes inside the book instead of a separate notepad, and a readable serif for ingredients and steps (Kalam stays for headings and notes).

Watch-out: the two-page spread still caps how much fits on screen, and skeuomorphism is harder to keep consistent as features grow.

Direction A · Counter — not chosen

Kept for reference. Flat warm editorial layout with a persistent recipe list and the AI as a command bar.
